hypotheses.rationale: The consistent pattern of object_4 leaving in the morning and returning in the evening on weekdays strongly suggests a work routine. The late return on Day 3 (22:36) and the presence of object_16 on Day 7 and Day 11 suggest occasional visitors or social activities. The unusual placement of object_4 at receptacle_13 on weekends (Day 5 at 07:25, Day 7 at 07:33) indicates the resident is up early on weekends or object_4 serves multiple purposes.

The presence of object_16 on Day 7 and Day 11 and the different movement patterns of object_14 (late return on Day 3) suggest a second resident with different hours. The early morning activity of object_14 and object_18 on Day 8 could indicate another person in the household with an early routine.

The timing of object_4 movement suggests a regular pattern but not necessarily a standard 9-5 work schedule, though the consistency is more aligned with full-time work. The weekend activity with object_4 at receptacle_13 at 07:25 is unusual for a work bag but could indicate the resident is up early on weekends.
